items.html: However, these nine Sefirot mentioned above, which are below the RDL"A, are those nine halls mentioned in the portion of Noah, page 65, and at the end of the portion of Pekudei, pages 268 and 269. And this is its language: "Rabbi Shimon raised his hands in prayer upward, etc., and then the light of the thought that is not known struck in the river of fire, and the river together, and nine halls were made. And the halls are not spirits and are not lights and are not souls, and there is none that stands in them," etc.
